{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])

# Calculate mean flipper length by species
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species', as_index=False)['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(by='flipper_length_mm', ascending=False)

# Print the full results to capture exact values
print(mean_flipper_by_species)

# Extract the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_species = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['species']
print(f"Species with highest mean flipper length: {highest_species}")

# Print the mean value for that species
highest_mean = mean_flipper_by_species.iloc[0]['flipper_length_mm']
print(f"Mean flipper length for {highest_species}: {highest_mean}")"}
